writeup.key_factor: Home favorite with the league's 2nd-best total offense (404.4 yards) and Bryce Young confirmed with no game designation after full practices all week; faces a 1-5 Tampa Bay missing WR1 Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot), RT Luke Goedeke and S Antoine Winfield Jr., with Baker Mayfield returning from a dislocated thumb wearing a protective glove.
writeup.risk: Carolina is missing both starting CBs (Jaycee Horn and Mike Jackson on IR) plus edge rushers Jaelan Phillips and Thomas Incoom; Mayfield's return could stabilize Tampa Bay's offense quickly.

writeup.key_factor: Showcase Gold: strong 2-0 home team at 1.93 decimal inside the 1.80-2.20 showcase band with the highest model probability in the band; Anthony Edwards (30 ppg) and LaMelo Ball confirmed with no designation, clean injury report on both sides except DiVincenzo and Bittle; Minnesota won both meetings last season.
writeup.risk: Toronto owns the league's best defensive rating through 2 games (90.5) on a tiny sample, and Minnesota is on the front end of a back-to-back with a trip to Cleveland on Monday.

writeup.key_factor: Showcase Gold in the band (2.17 decimal): home underdog off its first win against a Cleveland offense averaging 17.7 points per game whose quarterback has been sacked a league-high 24 times; Cleveland is also missing Teven Jenkins, Dillon Gabriel, Mike Hall Jr. and Kalia Davis.
writeup.risk: Calvin Ridley is questionable (hip, missed Thursday and Friday practice) and could be ruled out; the 12:00 PM pre-game check must confirm his status. Cleveland's elite defense (20.3 points allowed per game) can win a low-scoring game.
